hero.title: Formats for saved material
hero.subtitle: Formats you made and ones the community shared
hero.speech: Choose how to sort your material and which details to save.

mine.heading: My formats
mine.emptyBody: Formats you save from SecondB's suggestions appear here.

community.heading: Community formats
community.empty: No community formats yet. When someone shares one, it shows up here.

moderation.title: Report or block
moderation.body: Reporting hides this format from your list. Three reports hide it from everyone.
moderation.blockBody: Their shared formats stop showing in your list.

error.loadBody: Check your connection and try again.

toast.reportSuccess: Reported. This format is hidden from your list.
toast.blockSuccess: Blocked. Their formats are hidden from your list.

editor.autoMatchLinksHint: Links that match these rules are sorted using this format.
editor.savedFolderHint: Optional folder name. For example: tools/
editor.detailsToSaveHint: Details to read from each item and save with it.

schemaView.name: Name
schemaView.commonOnly: Only details used for every format are saved, such as the summary, tags and relevance.

add.title: Add a format
add.body: Describe your material and how you want to organize it. SecondB will suggest sorting rules and details to save.
add.placeholder: e.g. Podcast episodes - capture the guest and key claims
add.errorNeedDetail: Couldn't draft a filing guide. Add detail and try again.
add.errorDraft: We couldn't draft the filing guide. Please try again in a moment.
add.errorSave: We couldn't save the format. Please try again.
